name: RC - Order Portal
description: API behind Mahek's order page rajcreation.info/orders/: WhatsApp login code, list/view/edit orders, notify customers of changes, confirm & send PDF.

parameters.jsCode:
// One item per login row to save (new code, wrong try, used code, new session, logout).
return $('Handle').first().json.rows.map((r) => ({ json: r }));

// One row of the "Orders" tab in the leads sheet.
const o = $('Handle').first().json.order_update;
const LANGS = { hi: 'Hindi', gu: 'Gujarati', ta: 'Tamil', te: 'Telugu', en: 'English' };
const ship = Number(o.shipping);
return [{ json: {
  'Order ID': o.order_id,
  'Status': o.status === 'confirmed' ? 'Confirmed' : o.status === 'updated' ? 'Updated by customer' : o.status === 'cancelled' ? 'Cancelled' : 'New',
  'Order date': o.created_at || '',
  'Customer': o.name || '',
  'Phone': o.phone ? '+' + o.phone : '',
  'Shop': o.shop || '',
  'City': o.city || '',
  'Business type': o.btype || '',
  'Price level': o.level || '',
  'Language': LANGS[o.lang] || o.lang || '',
  'Items': o.lines_text || '',
  'Packets / boxes': o.packets,
  'Dozens': o.dozens,
  'Items total': o.items_total,
  'Handling': o.handling || 0,
  'GST': o.gst,
  'Total incl. GST': o.total,
  'Shipping': ship >= 0 ? ship : 'not set',
  'Grand total': o.grand_total || '',
  'Confirmed at': o.confirmed_at || '',
  'PDF sent at': o.pdf_sent_at || '',
  'Updated at': o.updated_at || '',
  'Version': o.version || 1,
  'Notes': o.note || '',
  'Chat': o.phone ? 'https://wa.me/' + o.phone : '',
} }];

// One item per WhatsApp message: the login code for Mahek, or the order update for the customer.
return $('Handle').first().json.messages.map((m) => ({ json: m }));

nodeGroups.name: Read request and data
nodeGroups.description: Parses the page's request and reads login rows, Mahek's chat state, orders, the customer and template names; Handle decides what to do.

nodeGroups.name: Answer the page
nodeGroups.description: Builds the JSON answer (adds WhatsApp send results) and returns it to rajcreation.info/orders/.
